wiki.title: Rob McColley
wiki.extract: Robert A. McColley (born October 14, 1984) is an American politician who serves as the state senator for the 1st District of the Ohio Senate, which includes Defiance, Hancock, Hardin, Henry, Paulding, Putnam, Van Wert, and Williams counties in addition to parts of Auglaize, Fulton, and Logan counties.
